title: What The Harp Knows — EN/ES/IT (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word observational 100bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal music philosophy Spanish Italian language learning harp Zimbabwe
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
The harp has forty-seven strings and seven pedals and the whole
Concert takes an hour to tune before it plays its role
The harpist arrives early and tunes for the full hour
And then plays something so beautiful it unmakes your power

[Verse 2 — Spanish, with English translation]
El arpa tiene cuarenta y siete cuerdas y siete pedales
[The harp has forty-seven strings and seven pedals]
El concierto requiere una hora de afinación — los canales
[The concert requires an hour of tuning — the channels]
La arpista llega temprano y afina toda la hora completa
[The harpist arrives early and tunes the full hour]
Y luego toca algo tan bello que deshace tu meta
[And then plays something so beautiful it unmakes your goal]

[Chorus — English]
What does the harp know that I don't know?
It knows that forty-seven strings and seven pedals run the show
What does the harp know when it opens up its sound?
It knows that whatever's above us and whatever's underground
Is listening — that's my boy

[Bridge — Italian, with English translation]
L'arpa ha quarantasette corde e sette pedali
[The harp has forty-seven strings and seven pedals]
Il concerto richiede un'ora di accordatura tra i canali
[The concert requires an hour of tuning between the channels]
L'arpista arriva presto e accorda per l'intera ora
[The harpist arrives early and tunes for the full hour]
E poi suona qualcosa di così bello che l'anima si infiora
[And then plays something so beautiful that the soul blooms]

[Outro — All three languages]
What the harp knows… Lo que sabe el arpa… Quello che sa l'arpa
Forty-seven strings, perfect patience — Cuarenta y siete cuerdas, paciencia perfecta — Quarantasette corde, perfetta pazienza
That's my boy
